Convert 2D landmark configurations to complex pre-shape vectors

Source: R/geometry.R
landmarks_to_preshape.Rd

Given a 3D array of shape (k, 2, n) of Cartesian coordinates, returns the (k-1) x n complex matrix Z whose columns are the corresponding unit-norm complex pre-shapes.

Usage

landmarks_to_preshape(X)

Arguments

X

Numeric array of shape (k, 2, n). Translation is removed with the Helmert sub-matrix and scale by normalising to unit norm.

Value

A complex matrix of size (k-1) x n.

Examples

set.seed(1)
k <- 4; n <- 5
X <- array(rnorm(k * 2 * n), dim = c(k, 2, n))
Z <- landmarks_to_preshape(X)
# Columns have unit modulus:
round(colSums(Mod(Z)^2), 12)
#> [1] 1 1 1 1 1
